# Tuna

Type: Fish | Internal ID: fish3 | Source: Fishing | Usage: Cooking | Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Tuna are passive creatures (fish) found in the Ocean biome.
They can be caught with a fishing pole using Heavy fishing bait which can be crafted at a Food preparation table using Fishing bait and a Serpent trophy.
Needed to craft a Fishing hat

### Crafting

• Result: Raw fish | Ingredients: • Tuna x1 | Crafting Station: Cauldron

## Notes

• Has a unique line: "I've got this tune stuck in my head..."

Categorias: Fish, Fishing
